race.description: 2026 Somerset Farms Darrell Alexander Trotting Championship Round 2 - Heat 2
race.comment: KEAYANG STUKA (7) looks tough to stop after a solid 2647m win last week in 1:59.2, showcasing the strongest recent form. He has bested SASSY GALLEON and GET USED TO IT in previous meetings. Can deliver again. SASSY GALLEON (3) is the key danger, having won her 2647m heat by a head in 1:59.5, and her prior G3 fourth at long odds suggests she can challenge the top pick. GET USED TO IT (5) needs to bounce back from being beaten by over 17 metres by KEAYANG STUKA, but his earlier second and strong record with Angus Garrard make him a credible upset chance. ZEALOUS SPUR NZ (6) was well behind SASSY GALLEON last week and in a G3 prior, but his strong 2138m record and driver combo can see him feature.
